evidence: A subject-centred view of the balanced graph is workable at one hop and not at two.
observation: Over 635 kinase targets the one-hop ego network has a median of 114 edges (p90 578, max 3,398) and 562/635 (88.5%) fit under 500 edges; the two-hop neighbourhood has median 1,396 (p90 12,375, max 37,033). A multihop peer question returned an answer for 977 of 1,000 sampled queries but with a median of 135 answers (max 196), so answers need ranking.
subject: F-100
title: Balanced graph is workable one hop, not two
